mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees under clear skies at City Hall, and we are currently experiencing a New Moon. The overnight low will drop to 68 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Regarding city news, road construction is set to begin on Highway M on August 18, which will include traffic shifts and the temporary closure of the driveway serving Alliant and Kwik Trip. Additionally, please note that election notices for the upcoming November general election have been posted at City Hall.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy a yoga session at Insight Wellness, grab pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or participate in trivia nights at either The Mill or The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy free live music at the Concerts in the Park event tomorrow at Century School Park.
For this week's police report, on Wednesday, August 6, an officer conducted a stop on a vehicle being driven erratically, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O W I, fourth offence.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and you can grab it at Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight.
